title: General Security Concepts
summary: Foundational vocabulary for SY0-701, covering control types, the CIA triad, zero trust, and change management.
details: Compared preventive, deterrent, detective, corrective, compensating, and directive controls across technical, managerial, operational, and physical categories
Mapped zero trust control plane and data plane components including policy engine, policy administrator, and policy enforcement point
Documented AAA, gap analysis, and the role of change management in security posture
Built a lab PKI with a private CA and issued certificates to Caddy on forge

title: Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations
summary: Threat actor profiles, attack surfaces, and the mitigation techniques that reduce exposure on a two-host lab.
details: Classified threat actors by motivation, resources, and internal versus external origin
Worked through social engineering vectors including phishing, pretexting, watering hole, and business email compromise
Reviewed application attacks such as injection, buffer overflow, replay, and privilege escalation
Deployed CrowdSec on both nodes and reviewed decisions against live SSH and HTTP probe traffic
Ran a Nessus Essentials scan against the lab subnet and triaged findings by CVSS score

title: Security Architecture
summary: Architecture models, secure network design, and data protection strategies applied to the forge and watch hosts.
details: Compared on premises, cloud, hybrid, IaC, serverless, and microservice architecture tradeoffs
Segmented the lab network into VLANs and enforced east west rules at the host firewall
Configured Pi-hole with upstream DNS over TLS and documented the resolution path
Implemented full disk encryption and evaluated tokenization versus masking for the Directus datastore
Drafted a resilience plan covering RTO, RPO, MTTR, and Borgmatic backup verification

title: Security Operations
summary: The largest exam domain, covering hardening, monitoring, incident response, and identity management.
details: Apply CIS Benchmark hardening to Ubuntu Server and record the delta from the default build
Centralize logs with Alloy and Loki, then build Grafana panels for authentication failures and firewall drops
Practice the incident response lifecycle from preparation through lessons learned using a simulated compromise
Configure SSO, MFA, and least privilege role assignments across lab services
Write automation scripts for user provisioning and deprovisioning

title: Security Program Management and Oversight
summary: Governance, risk, third party assessment, and compliance reporting concepts.
details: Build a risk register with likelihood, impact, risk appetite, and treatment decisions
Compare quantitative risk formulas including SLE, ARO, and ALE against qualitative heat maps
Review vendor assessment artifacts such as SLA, MOU, MSA, and BPA
Summarize NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and RMF alignment for a federal delivery context
Outline a security awareness training plan with phishing campaign metrics

title: Exam Preparation and Performance Based Questions
summary: Final review cycle focused on timed practice exams and performance based question drills.
details: Complete three full length timed practice exams with a target score above 85 percent
Drill port numbers, protocol pairings, and cryptographic algorithm selection from flashcards
Work performance based questions on firewall rule ordering and log analysis
Rebuild weak area notes into a single page reference sheet
Schedule the SY0-701 exam at a Pearson VUE testing center

title: Baseline Practice Exam
summary: Cold diagnostic run taken before formal study to establish a starting score and identify weak domains.
details: Scored 612 of 900 on an untimed diagnostic covering all five domains
Strongest performance in Security Operations, weakest in Security Program Management and Oversight
Missed the majority of questions involving cryptographic algorithm selection
Logged every missed question into a spreadsheet tagged by exam objective

title: Domain 1 to 3 Checkpoint Exam
summary: Timed sectional exam limited to the first three domains to verify retention before moving into Security Operations.
details: 90 minute timed run restricted to General Security Concepts, Threats, and Architecture
Target threshold of 80 percent per domain before advancing
Review incorrect answers against lab notes rather than course video rewatch
Rebuild flashcard deck from missed items only

title: Performance Based Question Drills
summary: Focused simulation work on the interactive question formats that open the real exam.
details: Practice firewall rule ordering and ACL construction simulations
Work log correlation exercises identifying attack type from raw entries
Complete drag and drop control mapping across the four control categories
Time each PBQ set to under four minutes per question
Repeat any drill scored below 90 percent after a 48 hour gap

title: Full Length Practice Exam Series
summary: Three full length timed exams under real testing conditions to confirm readiness and pacing.
details: Run each exam at 90 minutes with 90 questions and no reference material
Maintain a scoring log to confirm an upward trend across all three attempts
Require 85 percent or better on the final attempt before scheduling the real exam
Simulate testing center conditions with a cleared desk and no interruptions
Record average time per question to identify pacing risk

title: Schedule SY0-701 Exam
summary: Voucher purchase and seat reservation at a local Pearson VUE testing center.
details: Purchase the CompTIA exam voucher and apply any available bundle discount
Reserve a morning seat at a San Antonio Pearson VUE testing center
Confirm identification requirements and testing center policies
Block the two days prior for final review only

title: CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 Exam
summary: The certification attempt itself, with a passing threshold of 750 on a scale of 100 to 900.
details: Arrive 30 minutes early with two forms of identification
Clear performance based questions first, then flag and return as time allows
Reserve the final 10 minutes for flagged question review
Record the score report and add the certification to resume and LinkedIn on pass
Log the three year continuing education renewal date
